title: Dog & Footstool — Developmental Dossier
purpose: Explain how the existing Dog and Footstool concepts relate without creating a second identity definition for either concept.
scope_rule: Dog identity belongs to canonical_id `dog`; Footstool identity belongs to canonical_id `footstool`. This dossier owns only the relation between them, the two transition graphs, and the ground/response/growth synthesis.

closure.variant: Dweller -> Mud Dweller -> Dog -> tswine -> Footstool

development.meaning: assigned support -> active response -> generative possibility

two_transition_graphs.rule: These graphs measure different relations and must not be flattened into one rank ladder.

door_law: Proximity to a Door is not passage through a Door, and supporting another movement is not the same relation as undergoing that movement.
developmental_relations: Footstool -> Dog: local support becomes responsive function
Dog -> Potato: responsive function becomes generative possibility
Dog -> Footstool: pursuit can also terminate in a more closed local horizon on the closure graph
Footstool -> Door: local transition potential may exist before recognition
Dog -> Door: threshold behavior can guard, block, orbit or eventually change relation

recovered_layers.july_26: tiny Footstool microcosm with unfound central Door
recovered_layers.august_23: screen/interface motif: seeing an interface does not guarantee recognizing passage
recovered_layers.august_31: Dog orbital imagery and Footstool/dust substrate imagery

boundaries: Dog and Footstool are contextual project roles/symbols rather than fixed classifications of people.
Biblical comparison remains owned by traditions files.
Dog motion geometry remains owned by dog-return-circle-door-axis-atlas.json.
Farm/Guardian role detail remains owned by role ecology files.
Creative scenes are evidence of project development, not documentary evidence of external events.
open_questions: Which late-August Dog/Moon/Goat statements are direct user-originated material versus later synthesis?
Can the Footstool microcosm be formalized as a bounded local state-space with an internal undiscovered transition?
